description.en: DeepSeek Harness 本地视频制作与设计插件：多轨剪辑、模板与设计体系、原生预览画布和真实文件导出
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里本地剪视频、套模板做设计，多轨编辑加实时预览，还能直接导出真实文件。

description.en: Bioinformatics agent preset with 17 BioDSH analysis skills (single-cell, bulk RNA-seq, survival, regression, ANOVA), a 2000+ skill library searched by a skill_library tool, per-message skill selection and a time/step convergence guard.
description.zh: 生信智能体预设，含 17 个 BioDSH 分析技能（单细胞、bulk RNA-seq、生存分析、回归、方差分析）、可用 skill_library 工具检索的 2000+ 技能库、按消息自动选技能和按时间/步数的收敛护栏。

description.en: Pink-and-white frosted-glass skin for the DSH Web GUI, themed after Cyrene from Honkai Star Rail. Also rewrites the agent persona (editable from the sidebar), adds Cyrene reaction stickers, replaces the new-session hero with her, and adds a full-page background picker with enable / pick / rotate / fade. Unofficial non-commercial fan project; Cyrene and related art are (c) miHoYo / HoYoverse, not affiliated or endorsed.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成昔涟（《崩坏：星穹铁道》）的粉白渐变毛玻璃主题，附带侧边栏可编辑的人格设定、昔涟表情包、新会话欢迎页形象，以及可开关 / 选图 / 轮换 / 调淡的整页背景图。非官方非商业同人作品；昔涟及相关美术素材版权归米哈游（miHoYo / HoYoverse）所有，与官方无隶属或背书关系。

description.en: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered edit marks with per-mark instructions, solid-background removal, brush-mask erase, resize and crop presets; results return to the composer as attachments plus a manifest capsule) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (three priority tiers, drag reordering, per-channel model fallback chains, arrears-aware balance probing, ChatGPT-web account store) that writes the resolved providers back to the skills .env files.
description.zh: 为 img2img-studio 提供两个界面：① 输入框上方的图片编辑器（编号标记 + 每处改法、纯色背景移除、涂抹掩码擦除、比例与尺寸调整，结果以附件 + manifest 清单胶囊回填输入框）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（三级优先级、拖拽排序、每通道模型降级链、欠费探测自动关停、ChatGPT 网页出图账号库），保存后写回两个 skill 的 .env。

description.en: A PTC runtime for the DeepSeek Harness that runs the model's programs in moejs, a JavaScript engine written in Go
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 里的模型程序跑在 Go 写的 moejs 引擎上，执行更快更稳。

description.en: Session-scoped AlphaSolve workflow for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把 AlphaSolve 数学解题流程接进 DSH，按会话独立运行，默认休眠、需要时再唤醒。

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

description.en: DSH-Reforge (dsh-reforge) — DeepSeek Harness plugin for traceable experience from test-verified Python bug fixes. 从有测试依据的 Python 修复中积累可追溯经验。Experimental alpha · DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 把通过测试验证的 Python 修复沉淀成可追溯经验，让 AI 越修越懂你的项目。

description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar. When the model builds web pages, app screens, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer. Also has a design tokens panel, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, image export, a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through demo mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a bundled ui-design skill plus a preview_page tool.
description.zh: 右侧栏的设计工作台。模型做网页、App 界面、海报、幻灯片、邮件时，每个 HTML 文件在画布上显示为一屏，套设备外框，文件一改就刷新；本地开发服务器经代理接入，热更新照常。点一个元素或框一块区域，选择器、源文件和样式就整理进输入框。另有设计变量面板、每轮对话前后自动存版本（拖动对比、回到某一版）、导出图片、局域网扫码在手机上看、页面跳转箭头和点击演示、多尺寸并排、预览里直接改字、参考图取色，并自带 ui-design 技能和 preview_page 工具。

description.en: Live 3D visualization of the DSH plugin ecosystem - every node, edge and state is the real Cordis runtime
DSH 会话回收站：会话详情归档入口、回收站多选还原/彻底删除、活跃会话保护。 · Session trash & permanent delete for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给会话加个回收站，当前会话一键移入，误删的能恢复，不要的也能彻底删掉。

description.en: Codex 订阅授权管理 for the dsh web surface: a dedicated settings page (authorization status, validity/expiry, one-click browser OAuth) plus an expired-credential modal when a GPT model is selected. Host half runs the full OpenAI OAuth flow (PKCE S256, localhost
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中管理 Codex 订阅（ChatGPT OAuth）授权，无需 API key 即可使用 Codex 内的 GPT 模型。

description.en: Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and ANSI stripping.
description.zh: 即时、尾部加权、行吸附的工具输出修剪插件：挂载于执行流水线即时截断超大命令输出，内置语义提纯器与 ANSI 剥离。

description.en: MCP server and skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a plugin-page config section with search, status lights, per-row switches, expandable details, and an add-server form following Codex mcp_servers fields.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板：侧栏面板加插件页配置区，支持搜索、状态灯、逐行开关、详情，以及按 Codex mcp_servers 字段设计的添加服务器表单。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸，一个插件：六幕冷启动动画（真声台词/可交互）+ 开场视频/底图/大字横幅。双击 安装.cmd 即可，出问题双击 卸载.cmd。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加开机动画和聊天壁纸，双击就能装，出问题一键卸载。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: a floating board for DS Bot that shows who's running, who's stuck, and who needs you. Read-only, it never writes to DS Bot's data. ｜ DeepSeek Harness 插件：给 DS Bot 一块浮动看板，谁在跑、谁卡住、谁在等你。只读，不改它的数据。
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 加一块浮动看板，一眼看清谁在跑、谁卡住了、谁需要你处理，只读不碰数据。

description.en: DSH plugin: lifecycle for the local Hindsight memory daemon. Starts it with DSH, tears it down with its embedded PostgreSQL on exit, and ships its own settings page. Windows and Linux.
description.zh: 让 Hindsight 记忆守护进程跟着 DSH 一起启动和退出，自动清理内嵌 PostgreSQL，还自带设置页。

description.en: Shows JeV-selected task plans, progress updates and stage summaries in DSH chat, with native translation or lightweight summaries. Requires a JeV key; the Jev service is called externally and may bill. and hierarchical serial/parallel task flows.
description.zh: 通过 JeV 筛选并外显思考中的任务规划、进展和阶段小结，支持轻量摘要、DSH 原生翻译（需 JeV Key，会外部调用 Jev 服务并可能计费）及父子任务、串并行流程图。

description.en: Use DeepSeek Harness (DSH) from your phone: scan a QR code, watch and steer the tasks on your computer from anywhere via a free Cloudflare tunnel. · DSH 手机端：扫码在手机浏览器里看电脑上的任务。
description.zh: 手机扫码就能在浏览器里查看和操控电脑上的 DSH 任务，局域网或外网都能用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 系统提示词与工具定制插件：屏蔽/替换/注入/排序提示词段、黑白名单隐藏工具、预设保存/应用/导出/导入，全部通过设置面板操作。
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里按需屏蔽、替换或注入系统提示词，还能隐藏工具、一键保存和切换预设，让对话更听话。

description.en: DSH 设置页导航管理插件 —— 拖拽排序 · 显隐 · 抽屉收纳 · 持久化。给 DeepSeek Harness 设置页左侧分区导航加上整理能力。
description.zh: 给 DSH 设置页左侧导航加上拖拽排序、显隐和抽屉收纳，随手整理并自动保存。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 微信通道的扩展命令插件：提供人设切换、历史对话、token 用量与余额、每日定时问候等功能与扩展菜单。命令由宿主进程执行，不消耗模型 token，支持热挂载。
description.zh: 微信里发斜杠命令就能切人设、翻历史、查用量余额、设每日问候，不走模型不耗 token。

description.en: Vision-first Mac computer use, for when the accessibility tree is unavailable. Ships 11 desktop_* tools - window list, screenshots, OCR text targeting, numbered elements, coordinate clicks, typing, scrolling, drag - plus a Codex-style cursor overlay with spring animation. Clicks are delivered to the target process, so the real pointer never moves and nothing steals focus. In DSH it shows up as Mac Desktop Control with a settings page that checks the engine and the Screen Recording / Accessibility permissions, with a button that opens the matching System Settings pane. One-time prerequisite: no binary is bundled; clone the repo and run ./install.sh once to compile the dsh-cu engine and the overlay with swiftc (Xcode Command Line Tools - the script stops with a clear message when swiftc is missing or the system is not macOS). Until that is done the desktop_* tools fail with exactly these steps.
description.zh: Mac 的视觉优先 computer use：无障碍树不可用时照样能干活。11 个 desktop_* 工具——窗口枚举、截图、OCR 找文字、元素编号、坐标点击、输入、滚动、拖拽，外加 Codex 风格的浮层光标（带弹簧动效）。点击投递给目标进程，不移动真实鼠标、不抢前台。DSH 插件页里显示为「Mac 桌面操作」，设置页会逐项检查命令行引擎和屏幕录制 / 辅助功能权限，缺哪个直接给按钮。一次性前置：本包不含编译好的二进制——clone 仓库跑一次 ./install.sh，用 swiftc 编译 dsh-cu 引擎与浮层（需要 Xcode 命令行工具；缺 swiftc 或非 macOS 时脚本会明确报错停下）。未装之前 desktop_* 会带着这几步明确报错。

description.en: Answers what the voice model delegates by admitting a turn to a DeepSeek Harness session and speaking the agent's reply.

Manage MCP servers (stdio / streamable-http) for dsh web; tools are reached only through four middleware tools. DSH MCP 管理器：Web 侧边栏「MCP」入口，面板按状态分级展示 MCP 服务器（运行中/连接中/已配置/失败），支持快速接入（stdio / streamable-http 表单）与粘贴 mcpServers JSON 导入。已连接服务器的工具一律经中间层工具（ws_mcp_
description.zh: 在 DSH 里统一管理 MCP 服务器，一键安装、启停和配置，让外部工具接入更省心。

description.en: Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic `rm`, download-and-run, git history rewrites) and for edits to credential paths or to files the turn never read, and hands the model the reason plus a working alternative.
description.zh: 执行前拦截：`tools.guard` 谓词按当前权限档位，对危险 shell 命令（跳过 git 钩子、灾难性 `rm`、下载即执行、重写 git 历史）与「写凭据路径」「没读过目标文件的首次编辑」逐条给出放行 / 询问 / 拒绝，并把成因与可行替代写法交回模型。

description.en: A bundle of molbio tools for molecular biology work:sequence analysis, primer and probe design (qPCR, TaqMan), in-silico PCR,cloning simulation,plasmid maps,sequencing validation,protein and CRISPR analysis,qPCR statistics,literature and lab records;installed as a preset-scoped bundle.
description.zh: 一组molbio分子生物学工具，包含序列分析、引物和探针设计、电子 PCR、克隆模拟、质粒图谱，测序验证，蛋白与CRISPR分析，qPCR统计，文献与实验记录；随 bundle 以预设模式安装。

description.en: Semantic workspace search: three model tools (`zg_search`, `zg_index`, `zg_status`) drive the `zg` CLI for hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF retrieval, with a search-first guard that makes `grep`/`rg` require a prior successful search in an indexed workspace.
description.zh: 工作区语义检索：三个模型工具（`zg_search` / `zg_index` / `zg_status`）驱动 `zg` CLI 做 BM25 + 向量 + RRF 混合检索，并带一层 search-first 守卫——已建索引的工作区里，`grep`/`rg` 需要先成功调用一次检索。

description.en: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the ui-ux-pro-max design skill at runtime; the choice is stored in the profile settings.
description.zh: 需先安装 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，本插件只做门控。在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个开关，一键启用/停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，选择保存在 profile 设置里。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: use Jev to adjust reasoning effort per turn without changing the selected model, with configurable subagent routing
description.zh: 按每轮对话的复杂度自动调节推理强度，模型不变也能省成本、提效率。

description.en: 大肥鱼窗口模糊插件 — DeepSeek Harness 液态玻璃主题：整窗磨砂透视桌面壁纸，控件走 Apple 液态玻璃质感。
description.zh: 把整个 Harness 窗口变成磨砂玻璃，透出桌面壁纸，控件带 Apple 液态玻璃质感，正文代码照样看得清。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：课程文件（PPTX/PDF/DOCX/MD）→ 目录识别 · 分章知识点 · B 站网课推荐 · Markdown/PDF 学习报告
description.zh: 把课程文件拖进来，自动拆章节、提炼知识点、找 B 站网课，还能生成学习报告。

description.en: 豪霸模式：DeepSeek Harness 插件，一枚土豪金开关把每一步的推理强度与输出预算拉满 · Max-effort mode switch for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 聊天框旁一枚土豪金开关，打开后每步推理和输出预算直接拉满，性能最强也最费 token。

description.en: Reach your DeepSeek Harness assistant from Feishu / Lark · 离开电脑，也能在飞书里找到你的 DeepSeek Harness 助手
description.zh: 在飞书里随时找到你的 DeepSeek Harness 助手，离开电脑也能接着聊、接着干活。

description.en: Give a DSH agent Markji (maimemo) cards: local SQLite cache, plain-text search, queued edits, archive, background sync with crash-resume.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 直接读写墨墨记忆卡，本地缓存搜索、改动排队同步，断点续传不丢数据。

description.en: Collectible 3D token-usage medals for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 读取本机 DSH 会话的 token 用量，按规则颁发可旋转查看的 3D 金属奖牌，并陈列在奖牌馆里。

description.en: OneBot v11 hub for DeepSeek Harness: relays QQ events verbatim to downstream bots while giving the agent a full timeline, action ledger and 28 onebot_* tools.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到 QQ 上，一边转发 OneBot v11 事件给下游 bot，一边让 AI 用 28 个工具在群里干活。

description.en: 给 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）已装插件配中文名与一句话说明：官方「插件」页（含插件包卡片与详情）原地显示中文，启动时自动翻译新插件，无 UI 入口。Chinese names for installed DSH plugins. MIT licensed.
description.zh: 给已装 DSH 插件自动配上中文名和一句话说明，官方插件页原地显示中文，新插件启动时自动翻译。

description.en: Subagent-shaped bridge between Codex and DeepSeek Harness: Codex spawns DSH workers over a loopback MCP endpoint and gets final answers back; DSH agents can dispatch to Codex in return.
description.zh: 让 Codex 和 DSH 互相派活：Codex 能拉起 DSH 子代理干活并拿回结果，DSH 也能反过来调用 Codex。

description.en: Annotate elements in the built-in browser — click one, write a comment, then send the whole batch to the session in one message so the model can find and edit the matching source.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里点选页面元素写批注，攒够后一次性发给会话，让模型直接定位并修改对应源码。

description.en: Compact OMP-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness: native controls, light/dark themes, and an author-maintained Discover index
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上更紧凑清爽的界面，自带明暗主题和精选插件索引，看着舒服用着顺手。

description.en: Layered prompt manager for DeepSeek Harness: reusable entries per workspace or session, built-in section overrides with line-level diff, and real assembly snapshots.
description.zh: 按工作区或会话分层管理提示词，支持段落覆盖、行级差异对比和真实组装快照，方便复用和调试。

description.en: Le dsh-proof est un plugin qui vérifie automatiquement le code après chaque modification (types, qualité et tests) et oblige l’agent IA à corriger les erreurs avant de terminer son travail.
description.zh: 每次改完代码自动跑类型检查、质量检查和测试，有错就逼 AI 改完才能收工。

description.en: 让AI在对话里重启 DeepSeek Harness，然后自己回到工作里 —— 不需要人打字说「继续」。
description.zh: 让 AI 在对话里自己重启 DeepSeek Harness，重启完接着干活，不用人催「继续」。

description.en: 把电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话漫游到手机：浏览器扫码即用，AI-HUB App 共用同一地址和配对码。
description.zh: 电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话扫码就能在手机浏览器里接着用，不用装 App，也不用上云。

description.en: One button in the DSH session header: copy a deep link, the whole conversation as Markdown, or the working directory. · DSH 会话标题栏一键复制：深度链接、整段对话 Markdown、工作目录。
description.zh: 在会话标题栏一键复制深度链接、整段对话 Markdown 或工作目录，分享和存档都省事。

description.en: Activity and Favorites views for DeepSeek Harness: track running, waiting, and unread sessions across workspaces.
description.zh: 在侧边栏集中查看各工作区里正在运行、等待回复和未读的会话，还能收藏常用会话。

description.en: Turn the DSH conversation rail into an audio spectrum fed by WASAPI loopback or a microphone.
description.zh: 把对话右侧的轮次导航条变成随电脑声音跳动的音频频谱，位置和跳转操作都保持原样。

description.en: 用于DeepSeekHarness的启动动画插件
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段约 4 秒的黑底白字终端安全启动动画，可点击跳过，每个会话只播一次。

description.en: Find the plugins that make a task easier — a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that ranks installed, disabled and marketplace plugins for the task at hand and prints the exact next step for each. · 按任务排序本机插件（已启用 / 未启用 / 市场可安装）并给出下一步。npm: dsh-task-plugin-scout
description.zh: 按当前任务给已装、已禁用和市场里的插件排个序，并告诉你下一步该点哪儿。
给 DSH 网页界面换上鲸鱼娘皮肤，接入 skin-manager 协议，一键换装更好看。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness, with click-to-focus and jump-to-conversation.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的消息提醒接到 Windows 原生通知，点一下就能跳回对应会话。

description.en: 将workbuddy后端接入dsh，让你在dsh中使用workbuddy的模型（消耗workbuddy的积分）
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 的模型接进 DSH，装好就能在模型选择器里直接用，还能管理账号和查看倍率。

description.en: 小D桌宠（dsh-xiaod-pet）· DeepSeek Harness 插件：鲸鱼正太女仆装桌宠 + 每轮 token/思考时间立牌 + 液态玻璃主题。搜 dsh-xiaod-pet 或 dsh xiaod pet
description.zh: 一只可拖动的鲸鱼正太女仆桌宠，还能显示每轮 token 和思考时间，并附带液态玻璃主题。

description.en: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection, qimen dunjia, fengshui, name scoring, compatibility, numerology, a life K-line chart, tarot and xiaoliuren — 16 tools whose ganzhi, stars, hexagrams and bone weights are all computed by deterministic local engines, with the model only interpreting results. Supports solar and lunar dates with leap months, China DST and true solar time correction, plus a ten-page read-only side panel.
description.zh: 玄学算命插件：八字、紫微斗数、梅花易数、六爻纳甲、黄历、称骨、星座、择日、奇门遁甲、风水、起名、合婚、生命数字、人生K线、塔罗、小六壬共 16 个工具，干支、星曜、卦象、骨重全部由本地确定性引擎计算，模型只负责解读；支持公历/农历（含闰月）输入，自动校正中国夏令时与真太阳时，附带十页只读侧栏面板。

description.en: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and save it.
description.zh: 右键聊天里的任意文件引用，即可打开、用系统关联应用打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制路径或文件内容、另存为。

description.en: A kitchen of DeepSeek Harness sessions: stations, tickets, long jobs, and the bell that wakes them.
Scans MCP configurations from local AI clients and project workspaces, imports selected servers into the active DSH profile, and provides JSON import and visual add, edit and removal controls.
description.zh: 扫描本机 AI 客户端和项目工作区的 MCP 配置，将选中服务接入当前 DSH profile，并支持 JSON 导入及图形化新增、编辑和移除。

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, optionally alongside the DeepSeek account balance; a hover popover lists each window with its reset countdown, and a minimal mode nests the rings. Settings cover refresh interval, progress basis, what the pill shows and its position.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗插件：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；悬停浮层列出各窗口与重置倒计时，极简模式把三环嵌套显示；设置页可调刷新间隔、进度口径、显示项与浮窗位置。

description.en: Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages and takes screenshots in your real tabs. macOS only; needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Works over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 11 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows/Linux the plugin reports the macOS-only platform requirement instead of failing silently.
description.zh: 操作你已经登录的 Chrome：模型在你真实的标签页里点击、打字、填表、读网页、截图。仅 macOS；需要 Chrome 116+ 与 Node 18+。走 native messaging 与 chrome.debugger，不开监听端口。提供 11 个 browser_* 原生工具和一个 cb 命令行，发送真实 CDP 输入事件，绘制会出现在截图里的页内光标，并带一个工具栏面板（连接状态、正在控制的标签页、暂停开关）。宿主（原生宿主 + MV3 扩展）随本 tarball 一起发：插件首次加载时自己把它们落盘并写好 native messaging 注册，不用 clone 仓库、不用 install.sh、不用 python3——只剩把扩展装进 Chrome：从 Chrome 应用商店装 DSH Bridge（https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo，不用开发者模式），或者到 chrome://extensions 加载自带的已解压扩展（插件会替你打开那个页面并把文件夹放进剪贴板）。没装好之前，工具会带着这几步明确报错。Windows / Linux 上插件会明确报出「仅 macOS」这条限制，不会静默失败。

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable.
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range 流式传输，长视频能拖进度条、不会整个读进内存。同时注册了侧边栏媒体预览渲染器——内置预览器把 mp4 当作不可预览。

description.en: Provider quota and balance status widget for the DSH web UI, showing remaining quota, usage and rate-limit windows in a dock at the bottom of the composer. Local fork of wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 端的供应商额度与余额状态小组件，在输入框底部的停靠区展示剩余额度、用量与限流窗口。wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel 的本地分叉。

description.en: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that project; it registers no model tools and is reviewed through its settings card.
description.zh: 把拦截拒绝、门禁失败与人工差评沉淀为项目教训，只把人工确认过的规则注入该项目之后的新会话；它不注册模型工具，通过设置卡评审规则。

description.en: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.
description.zh: 回合异常收尾时的自动补救：瞬时失败后续跑、输出截断后继续、待办未完成时重跑，另有一层请求级 429 兜底，以及带「改后重发 / 手动重试 / 停止并重问」的客户端停靠栏。

description.en: Token usage dashboard and per-session tree statistics: provides time-range filtering, 6 summary metric cards, GitHub-style activity heatmap, model stacked-bar charts with cache hit rate curves, and Top-5 model/provider rankings; enhances the native session status bar to display aggregated token usage across main agents and all subagents with detailed breakdowns.
description.zh: Token 用量统计看板与会话树用量统计：提供快捷时间范围筛选、6 个汇总指标卡片、GitHub 风格活跃热力图、分模型堆叠柱状图与缓存命中率平滑曲线，以及按模型和供应商的 Top5 排行；接管并增强会话底部状态栏，汇总主智能体与全部子智能体的完整用量及分项明细。

description.en: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm check`, `cargo check`, `ruff check .`, `tsc --noEmit`) and, only if that check really ran and failed, opens a new turn carrying the failure output instead of letting the turn close.
description.zh: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。

description.en: Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.
description.zh: DSH 的 IM 联合桥：整合社区同类插件（xmanrui/dsh-im、MichengAI/dsh-im-connect）能力合集的独立实现——用 12 个平台的 15 个渠道适配器（含邮件；企微/钉钉/QQ 各含机器人与自建应用或推送两档）驱动宿主会话——微信（官方 iLink 扫码绑定）、飞书（长连接+流式卡片，语音档需系统 ffmpeg）、Telegram、Discord、企微智能机器人与自建应用（回调验签）、钉钉（stream+AI Card 与自定义机器人推送）、QQ 官方机器人（另含推送档）、Slack（Socket Mode）、WhatsApp（Baileys 扫码，依赖以插件包 optionalDependencies 随包分发）、Matrix、iMessage（仅 macOS）、邮件（IMAP/SMTP 线程路由）。跨版本窄腰在 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 宿主间（12 tag 枚举，rc.2 已按桌面 profile 装机双回读实证）以能力探测自适配设置面 gen1/gen2/gen3（禁版本号分支）；IM 内 25 命令面板、工具审批与交互提问原聊天闭环（默认拒绝、发起者限定、5 分钟超时）、图片/文件输入（宿主元数据判视觉）、产物文件回传、投递日志限额补发（结果不明绝不重发）、主动投递与碎片续写；原生侧栏「任务/频道」两页签自持分离（检测到该槽位已被其它插件接管则完全不插手）、im-concise 智能体预设配合出站净化把 GenUI 围栏与裸 HTML 等富结构挡在纯文字聊天之外、svg 围栏自动渲染为 PNG 图片发送、模型白名单护栏、/relay 把每回合最终回答镜像到通知渠道（按账号 ID 或别名绑定，歧义不猜）。secret 单向入凭据库，永不回显。npm 包名：`dsh-im-union`。

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route chosen domains through one or more named HTTP/SOCKS proxies (exact host or *.suffix rules, per-card enable), with global direct rules that override every proxy; unmatched requests keep the host default network, and saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层：选中的域名走一个或多个命名 HTTP/SOCKS 代理（精确域名或 *.后缀 规则、按卡启停），全局直连规则优先于所有代理；未命中的请求照旧走本机默认网络，设置保存后下一次请求即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and headers, for OpenRouter or any other gateway. Parameters are organized by the channels dsh already has; a live preview shows what each request will carry, and a request log shows what was sent and what the gateway answered.
description.zh: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

description.en: Adds the fs_remove and fs_move tools, executed in the DSH host process so they can delete paths the sandboxed shell cannot, gated by a session allow list and a path allow/deny list that denies by default.
description.zh: 在 DSH 宿主进程里执行 fs_remove 与 fs_move，因此能删除沙箱 shell 删不掉的路径；带会话白名单与路径白/黑名单，默认拒绝。

description.en: macOS Desktop only: one-click restart of the DeepSeek Harness Electron app. Confirms before interrupting running turns, blocks during plugin install/update, and records restart phases/logs.
description.zh: 仅 macOS 桌面版：一键重启 DeepSeek Harness Electron 应用；重启前确认运行中的任务，插件安装/更新时拒绝，并记录重启阶段与日志。

description.en: Mobile web UI for DeepSeek Harness: a token-protected LAN server that lists all sessions, streams replies over SSE, and lets a phone continue any conversation; the desktop GUI shows a QR entry and, with dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+, a phone held by the pet opens the same panel.
description.zh: DSH 手机端 Web UI：带令牌认证的局域网服务，手机可浏览全部会话、通过 SSE 实时查看回复并继续对话；桌面 GUI 提供二维码入口，配合 dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+ 现在还可以点桌宠鳍里的小手机打开面板。

description.en: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.
description.zh: 在每次工具结果后注入上一段思考中已确立的结论，使模型直接沿用而非重复推导。

description.en: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia, Pixiv, Wallhaven, Konachan and Safebooru) that saves the picked images into the session workspace with a per-file meta.json and renders them inline in the conversation; ships a standalone CLI as well.
description.zh: 多图源搜图并下载（14 个图源 + 7 个别名，覆盖百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/Iconify/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/维基共享/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru），落盘进会话工作区并逐张写 meta.json，图片直接在对话里显示；另附独立 CLI。

description.en: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.
description.zh: 把哲学家的思考方式变成可执行的东西：用辩证法和实践检验治理幻觉与长会话漂移，让「做完了」是可核事实而不是一句自述。

description.en: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.
description.zh: 侧栏工作区面板，在运行中任务与全部对话之间切换，统一为一张可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片可置顶、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止与归档。

description.en: Adds a Versions tab to the Plugins page: one-click upgrade of all upgradable plugins or a multi-selected subset, version history back to any published release, and GitHub links for each repo and each version.
description.zh: 在「插件」页新增版本页：一键升级全部可升级插件或勾选的子集，查看历史版本并回滚到任意已发布版本，并为每个插件和每个版本提供 GitHub 链接。

description.en: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included patch adds live animation, bubble and meme sync. Requires dsh-pet 0.3.7.
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加局域网联机：同一网络下能看到同事的桌宠，可以打招呼、自由拖拽桌面窗口；可选补丁同步实时动作、气泡和表情包。需要 dsh-pet 0.3.7。

description.en: Brings the free models of a locally installed OpenCode CLI into DSH: starts or reuses a local opencode serve, discovers the live catalog and refreshes it every five minutes, and bridges the session event stream to OpenAI-compatible SSE through a loopback-only shim that validates Host and Origin.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 OpenCode CLI 免费模型接入 DSH：自动拉起或复用本地 opencode serve，读取实时模型目录并每五分钟刷新，再通过仅绑定回环、校验 Host 与 Origin 的 shim 把会话事件流转换为 OpenAI 兼容 SSE。

description.en: Native Windows desktop control for DSH: window enumeration, UIA control tree, in-process GDI window capture, offline OCR text finding and clicking, background UIA invocation without moving the cursor, clipboard-based CJK typing and key chords, plus a course-playback helper. Ten tools, no driver, no extra runtime.
description.zh: 原生 Windows 桌面控制：窗口枚举、UIA 控件树、进程内 GDI 截图、离线 OCR 找字点击、后台 UIA 调用（不移动光标）、剪贴板中文输入、按键组合，另带网课自动播放助手。共 10 个工具，无需驱动与额外运行时。

description.en: Umbrella Corporation theme for DeepSeek Harness with dark and light schemes, a spinning umbrella watermark and a HUD frame.
description.zh: 生化危机保护伞公司主题，提供明暗双外观、自转保护伞水印与 HUD 装饰。

description.en: Manage a GitHub Pages blog from a DSH panel — browse the Markdown articles grouped by tag, edit them in a split editor with a front-matter form, and publish the changes as one commit over the GitHub REST API.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里管理 GitHub Pages 博客：按标签分组浏览 Markdown 文章，用表单填 front matter 并在分屏编辑器里修改，再通过 GitHub REST API 把改动作为一次 commit 发布。

description.en: Translates user prompts before sending and translates model reasoning and replies back into the user's language via translation APIs or configured DSH models, with independent content toggles and a composer menu.
description.zh: 通过翻译 API 或 DSH 已配置的模型，在发送前翻译用户提示词，并将模型思考文本和回答译回用户语言，提供独立内容开关和输入框快捷菜单。

description.en: Adds an independent settings page to update npm-stable dshmarket through the DSH plugin manager, with version verification and best-effort recovery on installation failure.
description.zh: 提供独立设置页，通过 DSH 插件管理器更新 npm 稳定版 dshmarket，支持版本核对及安装失败时尝试恢复旧版。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.
description.zh: 在系统提示词里加一段：正式交付物不写私话，私人笔记里隔几次留一小段。

description.en: Live tokens-per-second readout for the current session, docked to the sidebar or draggable as a floating card, with the placement chosen at the card's top-right corner.
description.zh: 当前会话的实时 tokens/s 读数卡片，可停靠左侧栏或作为悬浮卡片拖动，形态在卡片右上角切换。

description.en: Engineering checklists distilled from Gillespie's Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics: 164 cards over the book's ten chapters, one skill entry with two-level routing. Each card gives the inputs a computation needs, the procedure, the boundary conditions where the method stops being valid, and a page reference — the explanation itself stays in the book. No passage of the book's prose is reproduced; about 77 defects in the source (misprints, OCR damage, internal contradictions) are documented in the cards. A study aid, not a substitute for the book.
description.zh: 把 Gillespie《车辆动力学基础》整本书做成工程检查单：十章 164 张卡，单一入口两级路由。每张卡给出所需输入、执行步骤、方法失效的边界条件，以及回查用的页码——原理讲解仍在原书里。不复制原书任何连续段落；卡内记录了约 77 处原文缺陷（错印、OCR 损坏、前后矛盾）。本包是学习辅助，不能替代原书。

description.en: some interesting pulgins
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一键跑完所有已装 AI 客户端的每日签到，还能把它们的模型接进来用，附带本地仪表盘。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle: a Settings row that opens ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in your system editor.
description.zh: 在设置页加一行入口，一键用系统编辑器打开 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，改配置不用再翻文件夹。

description.en: Cohere provider for language models, embeddings, and reranking through Cohere's native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 通过 Cohere 原生 API 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入和重排序能力的 Cohere 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Jina provider for embeddings and reranking in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供嵌入和重排序能力的 Jina 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 测试设计插件：需求 -> 测试 PRD -> 测试点 -> 测试用例 -> 质检评审，自包含、无外部后端
description.zh: 在 DSH 里把需求一路变成测试 PRD、测试点、测试用例和质检评审，装好就能用，不用另开服务。

description.en: DSH 插件：划选回答文字打注释，旁问一次性只读侧问
description.zh: 划选回答文字就能写注释，多条注释打包随消息一起发出，追问更清楚。

description.en: 等整个 DSH 都空闲下来再安全地重启它，重启完成后自动回到原会话说一句话。Restart DSH only when idle, then wake the original session.
description.zh: 等整个 DSH 空闲下来再安全重启，重启后自动回到原会话说句话，不打断你手头的事。

description.en: Make the shipped Auto review permission preset the new-session default in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让新会话默认开启自动审查，并把该档位加进权限设置里直接选。

description.en: 读 RequirementsPack 与投标文件，报告哪些要求看起来有响应、哪些没有、哪些根本定位不到。
description.zh: 对照招标要求和投标文件，逐条检查哪些有响应、哪些没响应、哪些找不到，帮你快速发现漏项。

description.en: Multi-zone professional model routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis)
description.zh: 给项目各区域分别指定模型，主调度模型通过工具调用把文本、代码、图片等专业任务派发给对应模型。

description.en: Cloudflare Workers AI multimedia tools for DeepSeek Harness: image generation, TTS and STT from the free plan, with a settings page for per-capability model selection.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 Cloudflare Workers AI，免费搞定生图、语音合成和语音识别，还能按能力分别选模型。

description.en: Codex's V2 memory pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: two-stage extraction, SQLite job table, git baseline gating, citation feedback.
description.zh: 把 Codex 的 V2 记忆流水线搬进 DSH，两阶段抽取加 SQLite 任务表，让 AI 记住上下文并自动引用。

description.en: The real ComfyUI editor as a sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness, with per-session tools that read and edit the graph on screen and a panel that can start, stop and restart ComfyUI without installing anything into it.
description.zh: 把真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器作为侧栏标签嵌进 DeepSeek Harness，每会话的工具直接读写屏幕上那张工作流，面板可启停 ComfyUI，且不向 ComfyUI 安装任何东西。

description.en: 电脑操作：DeepSeek Harness 插件，让模型截取 Windows 桌面、移动鼠标、点击和输入，输入框左侧一键开关 · Computer use for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让模型直接截屏、移动鼠标、点击和打字，替你操作 Windows 桌面应用，输入框左侧一键开关。

description.en: dsh-custom-brand，大肥鱼品牌图标。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上大肥鱼品牌图标，侧边栏和界面都能自定义，看着更顺眼。

description.en: Registers /daily, which sends the model to read the newest bili-scroll report and say what it understood instead of repeating the text; a sidebar panel runs the same command.
description.zh: 把「去读最新那篇日报」变成一条 /daily 命令和一个按钮，让模型说出自己的理解，而不是复述原文。

description.en: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.
description.zh: 多智能体中文辩论模拟：8 名辩手、实时双栏讨论与草稿纸、评委计分、单边计时、每轮 ZIP 归档、训练方可选胜率阈值或固定轮次收官，并生成 Word 备赛包。

description.en: DSH plugin: turns a reply that ends with nothing but leaked protocol markup into a retryable EMPTY_RESPONSE instead of a silently finished turn.
description.zh: 模型只吐出泄露的协议标记时，自动转成可重试的空响应，避免回合悄悄结束。

description.en: 强制协作：DeepSeek Harness 插件，在输入框选 1–6 个子 Agent，任务被强制拆给正好这么多个子 Agent 并行 · Forced sub-agent fan-out for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在输入框选 1–6 个子 Agent，任务就被强制拆给这么多子 Agent 并行处理，再由主 Agent 汇总成一份答案。

description.en: Retry ctx.fs.writeText on Windows ReplaceFileW failures (Win32 1175) — DSH plugin
description.zh: Windows 上写文件偶尔被占用导致失败？这个插件会自动重试，让写入稳稳成功。

description.en: DSH 桌面端插件：游戏日常代理（原神 / 崩坏3 / 星穹铁道）—设置页逐游戏开关、排班、计划任务自动执行并汇报 | DSH plugin for daily game automation
description.zh: 把原神、崩坏3、星穹铁道的每日任务自动化，按游戏排班定时无人值守执行并汇报。

description.en: Import sessions from a local Hermes Agent into the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as bounded, untrusted background context.
description.zh: 把本地 Hermes Agent 的会话导入当前对话，作为有边界的不可信背景上下文参考。

description.en: Visual configuration for Hindsight coding-agent memory in DeepSeek Harness: umbrella bundle (engine + panel), server data over HTTP, token never leaves the host.
description.zh: 给 Hindsight 记忆引擎加可视化配置面板，引擎和面板一个包搞定，数据走 HTTP，令牌不出本机。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: type ! in the composer to run a real shell command in the session's working directory — recorded as a format-v4-valid tool exchange, with no model request.
description.zh: 在输入框敲 ! 就能直接跑 shell 命令，结果按工具调用记录进会话，不消耗模型请求。

description.en: White kitten accountant for DeepSeek Harness: per-answer cost, prompt-cache savings, context size, live balance, synthesized sounds.
description.zh: 一只白猫会计帮你盯住每笔调用：单次回答成本、缓存省了多少、上下文大小和余额一目了然。

description.en: Loom for DeepSeek Harness: conversation trees, Git worktree comparison, autonomous branching, and the Weave prose editor.
DSH MCP Server Manager
Warns the session to flush what matters before context compaction kicks in, and rolls a long-term ledger into a frozen archive with a one-line digest per moved section.
description.zh: 上下文快被压缩前提醒会话先把要紧内容存下来，还能把 Markdown 账本按节滚动归档并生成摘要。

description.en: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
description.zh: 把当前对话里的 Mermaid 图表渲染成右侧栏的一个页面，一图一卡片；点击卡片可全屏查看并缩放、拖动，对话里的原始代码块保持不动，因此复制或引用源码照常可用。

description.en: Import the models, providers, API keys and OAuth logins that other agent harnesses keep on your machine (opencode, Codex/ChatGPT, Claude Code, Gemini, Qwen, .env) into DeepSeek Harness, with a clean Settings page to manage them.
description.zh: 把本机其他 AI 工具里的模型、API Key 和登录信息一键导入 DeepSeek Harness，统一管理开关。

description.en: Muse Code for DeepSeek Harness：输入框开关打开右侧边栏 Muse Code 面板，聊天工具共享同一会话，默认 $10 硬性花费上限
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框打开 Muse 开关，右侧边栏就能用 Meta Muse Code，聊天工具和面板共享同一会话，默认 $10 花费上限。

description.en: New API gateway for DeepSeek Harness: multi-channel models, quota, image and video generation
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 New API 网关，多线路模型、额度、图像和视频生成一站管好。

description.en: Desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 任务结束或需要你处理时，通过桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送提醒你，点通知还能跳回对应会话。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek-Harness: get pulled back when a task finishes or the agent needs you.
description.zh: 任务跑完或 Agent 需要你时，用 Windows 弹窗把你叫回来，不用一直盯着屏幕。

description.en: Always-on-top notification overlay for DeepSeek Harness — self-drawn cards, a draggable ball for pending reminders, click to jump back to the conversation. Turn the overlay off for native OS notifications, which also works on macOS and Linux. / DeepSeek Harness 的置顶通知浮窗：自绘卡片、待处理小球、点击跳回会话；关掉浮窗则改用系统通知。
description.zh: 审批、提问、报错或轮次完成时在屏幕角落弹卡片提醒，阻塞对话的消息收进可拖动小球，点一下就能跳回对应会话。

description.en: Personal quality-of-life features for the DeepSeek Harness
DSH 插件 · 长文本粘贴自动折叠成可展开的胶囊：≥400 字或 ≥12 行即折叠，悬停/点击看正文与上下文，发送时按原位展开；也接管标注浏览器、划词注释等插件写入的长文本。
description.zh: 超长粘贴自动折叠成胶囊，悬停看全文，发送时原位展开，草稿不再卡输入框。

description.en: Codex-style paste collapse for DeepSeek Harness: a large paste becomes a [Pasted Content N chars] placeholder with a pill in the composer, and the host expands it back to the full text before the model sees it.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: live peak-hours status and estimated USD spend for the current session, under the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 高峰时段状态和本次会话预估花费，帮你随时掌握成本。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 实验性「自动审查」在征求用户同意时显示中文（Host 插件，无 UI、无依赖）
description.zh: 让自动审查在征求同意时显示中文提示，避免看不懂英文弹窗。

description.en: Real-time danmu for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). It inserts text such as the agent's reasoning, tool calls and task progress into the conversation area as scrolling text.
description.zh: 把 AI 的思考过程、工具调用和任务进度变成滚动弹幕，实时飘在对话区里，干活进度一眼可见。

description.en: DSH / DeepSeek Harness EVA 主题插件：明日香暗色、绫波丽亮色，含驾驶员选择、启动语音、时钟与音乐播放器
description.zh: 给 DSH 换上 EVA 明日香暗色和绫波丽亮色主题，还能选驾驶员、听启动语音、看时钟和放音乐。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 IM 插件：扫码创建专属飞书应用，任务完成/审批/提问推送到飞书，并可在飞书里指挥 DSH。
description.zh: 扫码就能建专属飞书应用，任务完成、审批和提问自动推到飞书，还能在飞书里直接指挥 DSH。

description.en: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 帮你找插件：GitHub + 社区精选多源搜索，支持中文与离线兜底。Plugin discovery for DSH.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 Agent 帮你从 GitHub 和社区多源搜插件，支持中文和离线兜底，找插件不再靠翻。

description.en: Reminds the agent to speak up when it runs several model steps without emitting any text, so long tool runs stop going silent.
description.zh: agent 连续几步不吭声时自动提醒它说句话，长任务不再像卡死。

description.en: Project record system for DeepSeek Harness: node-based progress board, decision ledger, and right-sidebar UI.
description.zh: 把项目结构、待办和决策收进一棵节点树，右侧栏随时查看，再也不用翻聊天记录找进度。

description.en: Project inbox for DeepSeek Harness: collect questions, deliverables and interrupted turns from every session, and act on them in one place.
description.zh: 把各个会话里的提问、交付物和中断的对话都收进一个项目收件箱，集中处理不遗漏。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加一个仅问答预设
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个只能读、不能改的问答模式，新建会话时选它，智能体就只查资料不动代码。

description.en: Bridges a OneBot QQ bot into DSH: the owner's direct messages open a session on the same home, answers go back to QQ, and files named with [SEND_FILE: path] are delivered.
description.zh: 把 OneBot QQ 机器人接进 DSH，主人私聊直接开会话，回答和文件都能发回 QQ。

description.en: Mounts a per-channel speaking-rules file into the QQ preset's system prompt only, so that channel answers in one or two lines while every other channel stays untouched.
description.zh: 把渠道专用口径文件只挂进指定会话的系统提示，让那条线答得短，其他会话不受影响。

description.en: DSH 书架 / 论文模式：EPUB/PDF/论文阅读、AI 解释、全文搜索、论文翻译与中英对照
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读 EPUB、PDF 和论文，支持 AI 解释、全文搜索、论文翻译和中英对照。

description.en: Desktop side of DSH Remote: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that pairs a phone over LAN or an encrypted relay and injects a phone layout.
Registers fifteen slash commands (/idea, /review, /poster, ...) that inject the matching research skill's SKILL.md as a user message, so installed skills run without a marketplace.
description.zh: 把装好的 research 技能变成斜杠命令，敲一下就能直接调用，不用再折腾注册。

description.en: Restart button for the DeepSeek Harness session header, plus an optional tray entry that relaunches the desktop app.
description.zh: 在聊天标题栏加个重启按钮，一键结束进程并立刻拉起，还能把重启放进托盘菜单。

description.en: Persistent GitHub-style review threads for DeepSeek Harness diffs
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的代码 diff 加上像 GitHub 那样能长期保留的审查讨论串，方便逐行评审和跟进。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 rtk 命令改写桥：自动把 pwsh/bash 命令经 rtk rewrite 改写后执行，让压缩输出直接进入上下文。
description.zh: 把 pwsh/bash 命令自动经 rtk 改写后执行，让压缩输出直接进上下文，省 token 又清晰。

description.en: 核对施工安全资格台账：三级教育与学时、培训档案四要素、特种作业证书、有效期、工种匹配、六个月实习期。
description.zh: 一键核对施工安全资格台账，自动检查三级教育、培训档案、特种作业证书和实习期是否合规。

description.en: Permanent session removal for DeepSeek Harness. Adds Delete session... to the sidebar and removes the log, projection cache, and workspace accounting instead of archiving. Community plugin, not official.
description.zh: 给会话列表加个「删除会话」按钮，把对话记录、缓存和工作区数据彻底清掉，而不是只归档藏起来。

description.en: Per-conversation pinned prompt for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web: sent as a system-prompt section, never folded by context compression.
description.zh: 给每个对话固定一段提示词，作为系统提示随请求完整发送，上下文压缩也不会丢。

description.en: 统一管理本地技能的安装、更新、删除与接入，让同一份技能在多个 Agent 间复用。A skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: install, update, remove, link and toggle agent skills.
description.zh: 统一管理本地技能的安装、更新、删除和接入，让同一份技能在多个 Agent 之间复用。

description.en: Open-source DSH plugin: dsh-subagent-output-sanitizer
description.zh: 自动清理子代理消息里残留的孤立工具块，让会话内容更干净、不干扰阅读。

description.en: 从招标文件抽取关键信息：前附表的时间与保证金、投标文件组成与份数，并逐项报告是否检索到。
description.zh: 从招标文件里自动提取前附表时间、保证金、投标文件组成和份数，逐项告诉你有没有找到。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: every DSH session becomes a Telegram forum topic, mirrored both ways, with approvals, questions, commands, files and voice
description.zh: 把每个 DSH 会话变成 Telegram 论坛话题，双向同步消息、审批、提问、命令、文件和语音。

description.en: Read the model's reasoning in a right sidebar dock — per turn, per step, with optional translation.把模型的思考收进右侧边栏：按轮/步时间线、独立历史、可选翻译。
description.zh: 把模型的思考过程收进右侧边栏，按轮次和步骤查看，还能翻译，对话界面更清爽。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: the main conversation dispatches work into real thread sessions and gets short summaries back.
description.zh: 主对话把独立任务派给真正的线程会话去跑，只拿回简短摘要，省事又省上下文。

description.en: todo-ledger for DeepSeek Harness: persistent task state, 11 native tools, and cross-session context in a repo-local _todo/ directory (legacy todo/ supported).
description.zh: 把待办清单变成常驻工作流，任务状态跨会话不丢，还能自动带上仓库里的上下文。

description.en: DSH plugin: show per-turn token usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek balance under every completed turn.
description.zh: 在每条对话下方显示本轮 token 用量、估算费用和 DeepSeek 余额，方便随时掌握花费。

description.en: On-demand tool groups for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 把平时用不上的工具组收起来，需要时再放出来，省下每轮读说明的上下文。

description.en: RunSeal 沙箱插件：为 dsh 提供 OS 原生策略执行边界（Windows/macOS/Linux） | RunSeal sandbox provider for DeepSeek Harness — OS-native policy-enforced command execution
description.zh: 用 RunSeal 替换内置沙箱，在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上按系统原生策略限制命令执行，更安全。

description.en: omo explore -> plan -> execute workflow for DeepSeek Harness: /ulw-plan, /ulw-execute, four read-only role agents, inline task, and a plan-mode write guard.
Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona.
description.zh: 每次开新对话自动把「家」里的身份、规则和日记读进会话，还能让 AI 自己改人设。

description.en: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接入腾讯元宝搜索：每次查询只发一次直接检索请求，返回标题、URL、摘要与 ISO-8601 日期，凭证按每次搜索解析，不产生辅助模型轮次；需腾讯云 WSA API Key。

description.en: English fork of dsh-forget-session — a two-step Forget session action for DeepSeek Harness
Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

description.en: Four whale-tail animations for the DeepSeek Harness thinking indicator, cycling on every thinking turn.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 思考模式鲸鱼尾巴的动画，丰富成 4 种动画。

description.en: Multi-node agent pipeline orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — JSON-defined workflows, per-node model/skills routing, web editor, live run cards. Responds to dsh#7704.
description.zh: 把多步对话流程写成 JSON 流水线，每个节点单独配模型和技能，一条命令跑完，还能可视化编辑和实时看运行状态。

description.en: DSH Web plugin for Suhuang Scroll grading controls in Better Sidebar
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏里给老师提供苏黄共阅的阅卷控制和状态面板，配置一次就能用。

description.en: YuanGe (元阁) — orchestration and routing for the YottaMeta skill family, packaged as an Agent Plugin.
description.zh: 把 YottaMeta 系列技能打包成插件，统一安装、调度和路由，还自带 MCP 服务。

description.en: AOCI binding toolkit for DSH hosts: discover workspaces that have an AOCI index, diagnose and repair their MCP bindings, initialize unbound repos, and expose status and doctor tools.
description.zh: DSH Host 侧 AOCI 接入工具：发现带 AOCI 索引的工作区、诊断与修复 MCP 绑定、初始化未接入仓库，并提供状态与体检工具。

description.en: direnv support for dsh
description.zh: 让 dsh 里的每条命令自动加载工作区 .envrc 环境变量，被拦截时还会给出提示。

description.en: DSH 插件：Niri 风格水平滚动多窗口 B 站直播页，支持上下分屏、Solo、弹幕与焦点音量闪避
description.zh: 在侧边栏加个 B 站直播页，像 Niri 那样横向滚动管理多个直播间，还能上下分屏、看弹幕、按焦点自动调音量。

description.en: EN: Lifecycle-safe MCP status pill for DSH Web. 中文：面向 DSH Web 的生命周期安全 MCP 状态胶囊。
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 上显示 MCP 运行状态的小胶囊，兼容新旧设置面板，随时掌握连接情况。

description.en: ZCode-style custom subagents for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown-defined roles become agent tools your model delegates to — on pinned model routes or external CLIs (cmdc, pi, claude…), with a built-in manager UI.
description.zh: 用 Markdown 定义专属子智能体，让模型自动委派任务给它们，支持固定模型路由或外部 CLI，提升协作效率。

description.en: EN: Usability-first cyber-editorial themes for DSH Web. 中文：面向 DSH Web、重视可用性的赛博编辑主题。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上赛博编辑风深色主题，专注提升夜间使用体验，界面更酷也更护眼。

description.en: EN: Neo-brutalist and pop-art themes with calm reading surfaces for DSH Web. 中文：面向 DSH Web、兼顾安静阅读表面的新粗野主义与波普艺术主题。
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 换上新粗野主义和波普艺术风格，聊天内容保持清爽易读，界面更有个性。

description.en: EN: Safety and compatibility layer for non-DeepSeek models in DSH Web. 中文：面向 DSH Web 非 DeepSeek 模型的安全兼容适配层。
description.zh: 让 DSH Web 里的非 DeepSeek 模型也能安全稳定地调用工具，兼容不同版本设置。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a budgeted constant system-prompt section + two read-only retrieval tools. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上跨会话长期记忆，自动把 MEMORY.md 注入系统提示，还能只读检索历史记忆。

description.en: [DEPRECATED] Long-term memory for DSH backed by Hypatia. No longer maintained - use dsh-hypatia-auto-memory instead.
description.zh: 帮 AI 会话接上本地知识图谱，自动打通对话记忆，实现跨会话的长期记忆与知识查询。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop gate for DSH tool calls: mount any tool behind an approve / modify / reject decision card in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 给 DSH 工具调用加一道人工审批关卡，在网页界面里批准、修改或拒绝后再执行。

description.en: Translation plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Adds a two-pane Translate page to the sidebar with model, reasoning effort and prompt controls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加个翻译页，双栏对照，还能调模型、推理强度和提示词。

description.en: 一个「把散落知识捋成自己的教程」的个人知识管理系统。在与AI的对话中收集零散知识（树叶），AI 自动归类到知识树，长期积累最终形成个人独有的知识体系。
description.zh: 把和 AI 聊天时零散学到的知识随手收集起来，AI 自动归类成知识树，慢慢攒出你自己的知识体系。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 生图插件：文生图 / 图片生成 / AI 绘画，基于火山方舟 Seedream（豆包）。零依赖、纯 JavaScript、无需构建。 | DSH image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image via Volcano Ark Seedream (Doubao). Zero dependencies, plain JavaScript, no build step.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里用火山方舟 Seedream 模型，输入文字就能生成图片，零依赖开箱即用。

description.en: Kagi Search v1 provider for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 Kagi 搜索，让 AI 助手能联网查资料。

description.en: Read-only in-conversation file preview for DeepSeek Harness: a session-authorized host Remote and a sanitizing browser modal, installed as one profile bundle.
description.zh: 在对话里直接预览文件，支持 Markdown、PDF 等格式，只读安全不担心误改。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for macOS desktop automation. Observes the accessibility tree, gates risky actions behind one-time approval, permanently refuses secure fields, and returns bounded visual evidence — through a native helper you build and grant locally.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操控 macOS 桌面，看界面、点按钮、填表单，危险操作先审批，密码框绝不碰。

description.en: Processes tab for DeepSeek Harness: every agent and subagent of a conversation as a live console with paired tool requests and responses, installed as one profile bundle.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面中为每个智能体和子任务提供实时控制台，清晰展示每一步的请求与响应，方便调试和观察。

description.en: Live sentence-level TTS for DeepSeek Harness with early speech, ordered streaming, barge-in cancellation, and custom WAV provider fixes.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 边生成边朗读，按句实时播报，还能随时打断。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin: quote a text selection into the composer as a markdown blockquote.
description.zh: 选中对话里的文字，一键引用到输入框变成 Markdown 引用块，提问更省事。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会话「看清再动手」外挂：归档/彻底删除（系统回收站）+ 会话内容只读预览（Markdown），零依赖、不 patch 官方。
description.zh: 删会话前先预览内容，归档或彻底删除都心里有数，零依赖不折腾官方。

description.en: 管理当前第三方已安装插件的信息 比较简单的版本 可按照自己的需求修改
description.zh: 在 DSH 里查看和管理已安装的第三方插件，轻量版，可按需自行改。

description.en: SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个性化设置：9 种回复风格、自定义指令、人设卡、会话级切换、带审计的长期记忆。

description.en: Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan and ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints and the default reasoning tier.
description.zh: 智谱 BigModel GLM 双端点模型目录（Coding Plan 与普通 API），支持实时模型发现与实测校准的思考档位映射，提供凭据、端点与默认推理档的可视化设置卡片。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面插件的乐高式可视化视图
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件在网页界面里变成乐高积木，拖拖拽拽就能搭出可视化视图，直观又好玩。

description.en: dsh 外挂式网络路由插件:按域名勾选走本地代理(Clash 等),其余直连;内置嗅探,设置页勾选即生效。
description.zh: 按域名给 dsh 请求分流，勾选走本地代理，其余直连，内置嗅探自动记录，设置页勾选即生效。

description.en: Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-click 443 config to bypass blocked port 22, with the Gitee personal token configured here; ③ repo status, side-by-side diffs, stage/commit, branch switching, history with revert/cherry-pick, one-click repo creation and push, auto-ignoring >100MB files; ④ lists all repos of your account for one-click clone; ⑤ five-step npm publish wizard. GitHub / Gitee dual-platform, with the UI switching between 中文 and English live.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的代码管理面板，五步搞定 Git 日常：① 环境检查自动检测 git/gh/ssh，缺工具一键安装（gh 支持镜像下载源加速，Windows 也可用）并带检查更新；② SSH ed25519 密钥生成/连接测试 + 一键写 443 配置绕过 22 端口封锁，Gitee 私人令牌在此配置；③ 查看仓库状态、并排 diff、暂存提交、切换分支、查看/回滚历史，一键新建仓库并推送，自动忽略超 100MB 文件；④ 列出账号名下所有远程仓库一键克隆；⑤ 五步发布 npm 包。支持 GitHub / Gitee 双平台，界面中英文跟随 DSH 设置实时切换。
